title: Exeter, Haven Road Retail Park: fire statement form for a mixed-use redevelopment with co-living and basements
jurisdiction: England, UK (Exeter, Devon). COMPARATIVE NON-ALBERTA RECORD; no Alberta applicability asserted.
code_edition: Building Regulations 2010 (Regulation 7 'Relevant Building' cited, p.12). BS 9991 and BS 9251 cited without edition year. ADB edition not stated: unknown if unstated.

facts.text: Application description: comprehensive redevelopment of Haven Road Retail Park, Water Lane, Exeter EX2 8BY, to four residential-led mixed-use buildings of 2 to 6 storeys with retail, cafe/restaurant and flexible Class E units, Class C3 residential and co-living (sui generis), plus two basement storeys for non-residential and ancillary uses.
Consultation: 'no consultation has been undertaken to date' with Building Control and/or the fire and rescue service (named 'Devon and Shropshire' as printed).

Blocks A and B have a top occupied storey below 11 m, with residential sprinklers designed to BS 9251 within the apartments. Blocks C and D are 'Relevant Buildings' under Regulation 7 and will limit external-wall materials to A2-s1,d0 or A1; Blocks A and B are also to meet Regulation 7(2) and 7(3).

Where single-direction travel distance in common corridors exceeds 15 m (Blocks A and C), the corridor is to have mechanical smoke ventilation of about 0.8 m2 free area per shaft, on smoke detection, with secondary power and duty/standby fans.

Block D: the stairway 'is not currently accessible from a fire appliance parking position along a code compliant access route'. The form relies on two possible entrances and 'assuming a single fire location as per first principles'; a dry riser inlet is to be provided at both entrances within 18 m of a parking position, and any horizontal pipework over 18 m is 'to be justified at the detailed design stage'.
An initial external fire spread assessment requires some fire-protected external wall areas on the southwest elevation of Block A and the northeast and southeast elevations of Block B.

Basement plant room: where single-direction travel exceeds the maximum, either the internal layout 'will be further developed' or 'an alternative means of escape shall be provided in the RIBA Stage 3'. Hob separation is also to be assessed 'at the next RIBA Stage 3'.
Secondary power to each block 'will at this design stage be provided from an on-site generator' for the residential and commercial sprinkler pumps.
Local policies: 'No additional document policies in addition to the requirements of the Building Regulations 2010 have been adopted at this design stage.'
Fire service site plan: 'provided as a separate plan' (Piper Whitlock ref PWA-000000-SK-0060 rev P9, 'Proposed GF Fire Access Plan'). That plan is not contained in this PDF.
A signature image appears on p.15 and the date is 27/06/2022.
